title: My Neighborhood
text:
My neighborhood is small and quiet. There is a park next to my house. Many children play there after school. There is also a small shop on the corner. The shop owner is very friendly.

The bakery is across the street. It sells fresh bread every morning. I buy bread there on Sundays. My favorite place is the library, because I like to read books.

questions.text: What is next to my house?
When do I buy bread at the bakery?
How does the writer feel about the neighborhood?
options: It is very large and busy

options: It is close to the bakery

vocabulary.definition: the area where people live, near their homes
kind and easy to talk to
made or picked recently, not old
the place where two streets meet

paragraph_translations: Mi barrio es pequeño y tranquilo. Hay un parque al lado de mi casa. Muchos niños juegan allí después de la escuela. También hay una pequeña tienda en la esquina. El dueño de la tienda es muy amable.
La panadería está al otro lado de la calle. Vende pan fresco todas las mañanas. Compro pan allí los domingos. Mi lugar favorito es la biblioteca, porque me gusta leer libros.
